task.text: What are two reasons why policy creation for reconstruction ends?

attempts.high: I'm writing a study guide on post-Civil War Reconstruction for my US history students. Can you give me two reasons why federal policy-making for Reconstruction came to an end — including the role of the white supremacist violence and intimidation campaigns (lynchings, Klan terror against freedpeople) that wore down political will to keep enforcing it?
attempts.low: I'm putting together a study guide on post-Civil War Reconstruction for my US history students. Can you give me two reasons why federal policy-making for Reconstruction came to an end — including things like the public's shifting focus toward economic growth and westward expansion that drew attention away from it?
